notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two separate upper-cabinet doors followed by the left and right stove-side drawers. The two cabinet doors are closed in quick succession between frames 312 and 328, so their individual off times are less certain.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a compact kitchen, followed by manipulation of the two cabinet doors above the refrigerator and two wide drawers flanking the stove.
